[SWS_PHM_00225]
{DRAFT}
Switch Global Supervision Status from
kOK
to
kSTOPPED
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status
is
kOK
, the
Elementary Su-
pervision Status
of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is
kEXPIRED
, the
expiredSupervisionTolerance
is configured to zero and the
GlobalSupervision
corresponds to Operating System, Execution Management
or State Management, then the
Platform Health Management
shall change
the
Global Supervision Status
to
kSTOPPED
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111, RS_PHM_-
00112)
See transition (9) in figure 7.6.
